note: A static if generate with a module instance in one branch. Fixed: hif-frontend#32 was hif-core's constant folder never folding a reduction over a constant, so the else branch's condition - which Verilog builds as the negation of or_reduce(cond) - never reached a ConstValue and _simplifyIfGenerate could not decide which branch survived. hif-core c726127 folds it; hif-frontend 329b178 stops partial flattening looping forever afterwards. Still paired with if_generate.v, which continues to fail in the backend on hif-backend#86 - the pair is what keeps the two apart, and it is more useful now that one half passes.
